label: ESTIMATE
hypothesis: H-BLOCKINV: the organizer metric is a linear measurement of the hidden truth field; invert it on a 300 m presence design and emit one dot per block while expected credit > 0.2*DTI
mechanism: DTI = TP/(0.2D+0.8N) has no TP in the denominator, so each published score fixes the truth credit of its own dot set; a presence-in-300m-block design makes the fitted coefficient the credit of one emitted dot
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: chunk selection: if the scored public split is enriched in faults, a dispersed field inherits a higher capture rate without any skill (H-selection, docs/research/why-02778-20261030.md section 3)
statistic: leave-one-file-out prediction of 128 published OWNER-REPORT scores

validator_output.note: no NaN inside the footprint, values in [0,1], binary, CRS/shape/transform match the official grid, estimate recomputed from the raster

negative_results: block counts beat exact-dot incidence but lose to presence (0.0330 vs 0.0205)
averaging designs at 2/3/4/6 px did not beat 3 px alone (0.0206-0.0215 vs 0.0205)
checking the uniqueness ratio incrementally collapses the estimate to 0.121; the quota must come from the final dot count
